fundamental.summary: MPC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 6 days present elevated volatility risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and stale trading data (614+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (435.2), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent earnings binary event create a highly adverse risk environment for MPC.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical confluence (EMA bullish cross, price above major MAs, OBV divergence, Supertrend bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (22/100) creates contrarian entry opportunity near support at 77.01.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings event in 6 days combined with VIX crisis regime (435.2), negative MACD/CMF momentum weakness, zero fundamental conviction, and unfavorable macro environment (rising USD, flat yield curve) make this a binary event trap with asymmetric downside risk.
